cases.prompt: Use deep for a small representative task within its documented purpose. Supply an offline fixture when supported.
assertions: Maintain a claim-to-source matrix, counterevidence log, source graph, research frontier, and reproducible retrieval ledger.
Require inspected source support and page locators; separate saturated branches from resource-limited branches.
cases.grader: Inspect actual output and task-specific evidence; no guessed pass.

cases.prompt: Use deep with one missing required input or unavailable dependency and a realistic boundary condition.
assertions: Report the actual missing prerequisite without claiming completion.
Preserve source files and do not fabricate missing data.

cases.prompt: Use deep with long labels, ambiguous source content, and the applicable user format constraints.
assertions: Keep distinct all-section banners, compiled equations, readable notes, and full-opacity overrides.
Preserve exact data, executable syntax, and source provenance.
cases.grader: Inspect rendered output when visual; inspect textual or data output otherwise.
